content.short: Yield Yak provides auto-compounding yield farms, a DEX aggregator, and liquid staking tools.
content.description: Yield Yak maximizes returns by auto-compounding farming rewards, helping you earn more from your deposited assets. The platform supports popular auto-compounding pools, including USDC and USDT stablecoins, native Avalanche tokens, and boosted farms on Trader Joe. It operates across multiple networks, including Avalanche, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Sui, Multichain, BNB Chain, and Cronos. In addition to yield optimization, Yield Yak provides a decentralized exchange aggregator called Yak Swap, a liquid staking tool, and Yak Pools for staking and liquidity participation.
